scope: One authored development reference through real upload, analysis, blueprint, generation, validation, review and export workflow. No holdout, oracle source or oracle truth was sent to inference.
limitations: One authored case is diagnostic evidence, not a quality estimate or arbitrary-site generalization claim.
The live model-produced VisualSpec was submitted automatically without human correction; no independent visual review was performed.
Studio acceptance was not reached, so no candidate pixel/fidelity metrics or export were produced.
The failure happened before the per-attempt job-audit change; equivalent route/error/latency data came from private operational telemetry. New deterministic tests verify the job audit and UI path.
Free-route availability is dynamic. A zero-price-only policy and bounded retries constrain cost; they do not guarantee availability or quality.
